newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: BP makes best bid in new Sri Lanka fuel oil tender.
newsitem.headline: BP makes best bid in new Sri Lanka fuel oil tender.

text.p: British Petroleum has made the highest bid into Sri Lankan state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp's (CPC) tender to sell 19,000 tonnes of fuel oil, a CPC official said on Friday.
The bid at $9.50 per tonne below Singapore spot quotes, on a free-on-board Colombo basis, is for CPC's revised tender for August 30-September 1 lifting dates.

CPC's original tender offered the cargo for August 27-28 lifting but had to change the lifting dates. Marubeni International Petroleum Corp made the highest bid into that tender but for later lifting dates.
Marubeni made the next best offer of $9.88 per tonne below Singapore spot quotes for the revised tender, the official said.
CPC will decide on the winner later on Friday.
In its previously awarded tender, CPC sold 20,000 tonnes of 3.5 percent sulphur fuel oil at a discount of $14.75 per tonne to Singapore spot quotes on an fob Colombo basis, for July 22-23 lifting.
